adjusted_prescription: To effectively identify and extract dates and events from narrative or unstructured text, you should focus on teaching the system to recognize key temporal words and phrases such as "before," "after," "on," and specific date formats. The demonstration needs to show how to pinpoint when each event occurs and then arrange these events in the correct chronological order. It should also show how to connect each event to the related actions or outcomes mentioned in the text. This approach will enable the system to understand sequences and timing, making it possible to reason about the flow of events and their relationships. Including examples with a variety of time expressions and event descriptions will strengthen the system’s ability to handle real-world text. This type of demonstration is important for processing and interpreting timelines embedded in natural language passages.
